Not reachable with a bad rate from the host (ProcessConfig::validate at types.rs:134-135 runs in activate_isolated at host.rs:409, before admit/verify_content/start_worker at :433-446), and the refusal value is still E_CONFIG. verified_fixes: PLR-054 FIXED: one rule. types.rs:110-114 validate_sample_rate = hsk_studio_score::ticks_per_sample (score layout.rs:79-87: rate > MAX_SAMPLE_RATE_HZ (768_000, layout.rs:11) -> InvalidRate, else Timescale exact_ticks_per_unit, so 0 and non-divisors are refused) mapped to InvalidConfig. Called at the three decision sites and nowhere else re-implemented: ProcessConfig::validate types.rs:135, Reference::configure backend.rs:212, ClapBackend::configure clap_backend.rs:187. The three MAX_SAMPLE_RATE_HZ imports and compare lines are gone (regex below).

Every entry point: the only constructor of a configured worker is IsolatedHost::activate_isolated (host.rs:400-503); PluginProvider::activate delegates to it (host.rs:567-574); probe (host.rs:507-565) sends no configure and carries no rate. In activate_isolated the order is cancel, deadline, authorize, config.validate() (host.rs:409), then budget math, supervisor.admit (:433-437), verify_content, spec_of, start_worker (:440-446) and only then ConfigureSpec{sample_rate_hz} (:448-449). So a refused rate never reaches admit or spawn. ConfigureSpec is otherwise constructed only by the wire decoder (wire.rs:446-461, worker side; the worker's only consumer is worker.rs:174-175 -> backend.configure, which validates) and a wire unit test (wire.rs:752). No reconfigure/set-rate API exists on IsolatedInstance (grep sample_rate_hz: host.rs:585 field, :747-748 accessor, :768 equality with the block rate after input.validate() at :766).

No 'admitted, fails later' path left: a configured rate passes ticks_per_sample, a block must equal it (host.rs:768-770) and InputBlock::validate applies the same ticks_per_sample, so an activated instance cannot fail its first block on the rate.

Tests would fail if reverted: foundation_contract.rs sample_rate_is_refused_at_activation_before_any_spawn (new, +80 lines) refuses 0, 44_101, 47_999, 22_051, 96_001, 11_000, 768_001, 1_536_000, u32::MAX through activate_isolated AND the trait activate, then asserts stats (spawned, workers_live, in_flight_bytes) == (0, 0, 0); five of those rates (44_101, 47_999, 22_051, 96_001, 11_000) passed the old 0/MAX check, so the old host activates a worker (lane red proof: IsolatedInstance{state: Active} at 44_101). The accepted side activates 8_000..768_000 (spawned == 6) and runs one 44_100 Hz block bit-exact. rate_gate_tests.rs pins each worker backend separately over a 28-rate table (Reference::configure -> E_CONFIG for refused; ClapBackend::configure -> E_CONFIG for refused, E_UNAVAILABLE for admitted, which also proves the rate check precedes staging) and first asserts the table equals score's rule, so reverting any one site is red independently. Hand factorisations checked: 47_999 = 7 x 6_857 (prime), 768_000 = 2^11 x 3 x 5^3, 1_536_000 = 2^12 x 3 x 5^3 (divisor above the bound), 254_016_000_000 / 768_000 = 330_750.

The difftest lane's D1 gate_impact said 'none found' because it only checked src (('img' | 'image', 'src') is listed). 4d80e50 closes it as a side effect of D1 (local_name). No test pins it: grep of tests/ finds no <image ... srcset> and no collect_assets call on an HTML <image>; reverting assets.rs:640 to the source tag name would stay green.
findings.remediation: In the web remediation: add one asset-gate test (<image srcset="https://e.invalid/x 1x"> and <IMAGE srcset=...> -> Denied(external_scheme), plus a relative candidate reaching the port); record the closed f6e5a49 gap against SMB-WEB (CX-VAL-009)
